summary: Frontend testing completed for Patient Categories feature on SurgiFlow OR Scheduling Platform. All 9 test cases passed. Category filter pills, Group by Category toggle, color-coded borders, patient card expansion, search functionality, and regression tests for Dashboard/Calendar all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing patients (Andrew Burton, Friedderich Will, Harste Kenneth)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patient Categories feature fully implemented and tested. Categories: Orthognathic (2 patients - Andrew Burton, Friedderich Will), Other (1 patient - Harste Kenneth). All category filter pills working with correct counts. Group by Category toggle groups patients under category headers with colored dots. Color-coded left borders: violet for Orthognathic, slate/teal for Other. Patient card expansion shows Patient Details, Pre-Op Checklist, and Tasks sections. Search filters patients correctly. Dashboard and Calendar tabs load without issues.
